items.title: How LoanPro built an agentic AI loan servicing assistant with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: LoanPro worked with AWS Partner AllCloud and the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center to build a multi-agent AI assistant on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It gives loan servicing agents instant borrower context and next-best-action recommendations, reducing customer call times by up to 15 percent.
items.creator: Mariah Miller

items.title: Responsible AI for agentic AI: A phased roadmap for platform and application teams
items.summary: Enterprises adopting agentic AI at scale need platforms that embed responsible AI from the start. This post gives platform and application teams a three-phase roadmap (governance foundation, pilot deployment, and evaluation and hardening) that maps the AWS Responsible AI Lens pillars to each phase, with guidance on when to revisit each one.
items.creator: Mia Chang
